summary: Cleocharia is a Naiad nymph in Greek mythology, named by Pseudo-Apollodorus as the wife of the earth-born Lelex and mother of Eurotas, the eponym of the Laconian river and ancestor of the Spartan royal line through his daughter Sparta.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollodorus (Bibliotheca 3.10.3) makes Eurotas a son of Lelex by the Naiad Cleocharia. Pausanias instead inserts Myles between Lelex and Eurotas and does not name Cleocharia.
